    features["has_alpha"] = features["before"].str.contains(r"[а-яА-ЯёЁ]").astype(int)

    )

        features["before"].str.contains(r"^\d{1,2}:\d{2}$").astype(int)
    )

    for col in ["prefix2", "suffix2"]:

    return features
